levels.surface: الصادق أبي عبد الله جعفر بن محمد

notes: The stray dash inside «سعد بن - عبد الله» is kept as the text writes it; «رضي الله عنهما» and «عليهما السلام» are formulas and are left out.
The Imam after «عن» stays a narrator in the chain (owner ruling 2); the laqab and kunya are written as the text gives them.
